name: Depression-Era Wacky Cake
description: A one-bowl (or rather, one-pan) chocolate cake with no eggs and no dairy, mixed and baked in the same dish. Swap the water for cold coffee for a deeper flavor.
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). In the pan you'll bake in, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt.
Make three wells in the dry mixture: pour oil into one, vinegar into another, and 1 cup cold water into the third.
Whisk everything together directly in the pan until smooth — no eggs, no extra bowl needed.
Bake 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: 3-Minute Microwave Mug Cake
description: A single-serving chocolate cake mixed and baked in a mug, ready before the kettle would've boiled.
steps: In a large mug, whisk flour, sugar, cocoa powder, and baking powder together.
Stir in milk and oil until smooth.
Microwave on high for 90 seconds to 2 minutes until risen and set.
Let cool for 1 minute, then eat straight from the mug.

name: Yogurt Pot Cake (Gâteau au Yaourt)
description: The classic French kids'-first-recipe cake — you measure everything using the empty yogurt container, no scale required.
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) and grease a loaf pan. Empty one pot of yogurt into a bowl, then rinse and keep the pot as your measuring cup.
Whisk in 2 pots of sugar, 1/2 pot of oil, the eggs, and vanilla.
Stir in 3 pots of flour and 1 pot's worth of baking powder (about 2 teaspoons) until just combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 40-45 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: No-Eggs Applesauce Snack Cake
description: A moist, eggless spice cake that leans on applesauce for both moisture and binding.
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) and grease an 8-inch pan.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt together.
Stir in applesauce and oil until just combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Self-Rising Emergency Pound Cake
description: A dense, buttery pound cake that only needs five ingredients if your flour is already self-rising.
steps: Preheat oven to 160°C (325°F) and grease a loaf pan.
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in eggs one at a time and the vanilla.
Fold in self-rising flour until just combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 50-55 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Three-Ingredient Condensed Milk Sponge
description: About as close to a true emergency cake as it gets — sweetness and richness both come from the condensed milk.
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) and grease a round pan.
Whisk eggs until frothy, then whisk in the condensed milk.
Fold in self-rising flour until just combined with no dry streaks.
Pour into the pan and bake 25-30 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Lemon Yogurt Drizzle Cake
description: A brighter cousin of the yogurt pot cake, finished with a tangy lemon drizzle instead of frosting.
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) and grease a loaf pan.
Whisk yogurt, sugar, eggs, and oil together, then stir in flour and baking powder until just combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
While still warm, whisk lemon juice with a little extra sugar and poke holes in the top of the cake, then pour the drizzle over so it soaks in.
